name: Stage 39: Västra Kovik to Dragsviken
description: Official Sörmlandsleden stage 39, Västra Kovik to Dragsviken.
utilities: Västra Kovik/Koviksbadet is the strongest access and service cluster, with parking, bathing, dry toilet, grill/fireplace, benches, and bin at the start.
Viggudden is the main overnight/rest node on the stage, with an official Sörmlandsleden shelter, nearby toilet, and fireplace/grill context. The shelter roof was renovated in April 2026.

Dragsviken is a low-service endpoint and stage 40 junction. Official stage 40 information says there is no parking at the stage start; use Långsjöns fågeltorn/Gäddfabriken parking about 1 km away when exact access fits the itinerary.

Public transport is weak at both endpoints. Naturkartan finds no nearby stops; fixed bus stops are off-route and complementary traffic around Hummelvik/Östra Kovik/Ålbäck can require advance weekday booking.
waterSources: No verified potable refill was found on stage 39. Carry enough water from before Västra Kovik or from the previous verified refill at Uttervik on stage 38.
Vindskyddskartan lists water of unknown quality at/near Viggudden, and an abandoned mapped well near Västra Kovik should not be used for planning. Treat both as non-potable unless verified on site.
Västra Kovik, Viggudden, and the coast offer sea/bathing water only, not drinking-water refill.
notes: Sörmlandsleden does not guarantee water quality or availability; treat or filter natural sources and carry backup.
Shelters are generally free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, and do not guarantee firewood or trash service.
In nature reserves, local camping and fire rules override allemansrätten; fires are often restricted to prepared fireplaces.

Official Sörmlandsleden and the long-distance passport list stage 39 as 6 km, while Naturkartan exposes about 5639 m, OSM relation 3822358 measures about 5.8 km, Trail Run Project 5.8 km, Äventyrligare 5.77 km, and the local app GeoJSON measures about 5.71 km. Use 6 km as the official planning distance with a soft mapped-line caveat.

Main-route topology is continuous from stage 38 at Västra Kovik to stage 40 at Dragsviken. For route-builder stitching, snap to OSM node 2889603613 at 58.618465,16.938396 and OSM node 2889662498 at 58.632850,17.004986. Do not merge the Västra-Östra Kovik/Bråten loop into the main stage; it is an optional local loop.

This is a short but demanding red/krävande coastal stage, described by official and regional sources as one of Sörmlandsleden's longest coastal stretches, with repeated rocky climbs, exposed slabs, roots, and big Bråviken/Baltic views.

Hiker reports describe slow travel despite the short distance, with many ups and downs, steep rock, root/crack handholds, rope-assisted passages in places, and high water demand in warm weather. No reliable Stage 39 ladder report was found.
Official text notes cattle may be present in a pasture inside the bay at Östra Kovik. Keep dogs controlled/leashed, close gates, and pass livestock calmly.

No dedicated campsite was found beyond shelter use at Viggudden, though user reports mention tentable spots nearby. Do not present Västra Kovik beach as a tent spot; Nyköping public-place rules restrict public-place camping to named designated areas. Use normal allemansrätten judgment only where permitted, avoid houses, gardens, pastures, fragile coastal ground, sensitive shore/bird areas, and follow local signs.

Fires should only be at prepared fireplaces/grill places such as Västra Kovik or the Viggudden shelter area, and only when current Nyköping/Sörmlandskusten fire-ban status allows it. Bring fuel and never make informal fires on coastal rock slabs because they can crack.
Viggudden shelter is free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked, has no trash service, and firewood is not provided. User reports confirm it is a real overnight/rest node, but it can be occupied.
Ålbäck fishing village is a coastal/cultural landmark on the stage. The route passes the fishing-place area before leaving the coast; use an approximate marker unless field-verified.

The shorter Västra Kovik-Östra Kovik-Bråten loop has a prepared grill place after about 1 km according to official text, but the exact coordinate was not confirmed; show it as an approximate local-option marker only.
The route passes/near cottage areas and Ålbäck fishing settlement; stay on marked trail/roads, avoid private jetties and yards, and keep noise low.
The official page showed no current fault reports during the 2026-04-27 research pass.

facilities.name: Västra Kovik / stage 39 start
facilities.description: OSM topology endpoint shared with stage 38; official stage start marker is nearby at 58.618433,16.938417 in the beach/access cluster.

facilities.name: Västra Kovik parking
facilities.description: Good start parking at the beach cluster; check local signs for longer stays.

facilities.name: Västra Kovik dry toilet
facilities.description: Dry toilet at/near the beach, supported by OSM/Naturkartan/Havs- och vattenmyndigheten context.

facilities.name: Västra Kovik beach
facilities.description: Municipal bathing-place cluster and strong rest/swim point; not a potable-water source. 2025 samples were usable with no algal bloom, but check current bacteria/algae status before swimming.

facilities.name: Badplats Kovik grill place
facilities.description: Prepared beach grill/rest area with dry toilet, bin, benches, and beach access listed by Naturkartan/Grillplatser. Bring fuel, pack out waste, and check fire-ban status.

facilities.name: Approximate grill on Östra Kovik loop
facilities.description: Approximate local-loop marker only. Official Stage 39 text says a prepared grill place sits about 1 km from Västra Kovik on the shorter loop option; exact coordinate not confirmed. Bring wood or charcoal.

facilities.name: Östra Kovik pasture caution
facilities.description: Livestock/gate caution from official stage text: cows may be present in a pasture inside the bay at Östra Kovik. Close gates and leash/control dogs.

facilities.name: Viggudden shelter
facilities.description: Official shelter about 2 km from Västra Kovik. Free, shared, first-come, cannot be booked; roof renovated April 2026. User reports confirm it is used and can be occupied.

facilities.name: Viggudden shelter fireplace
facilities.description: Fireplace/grill context at the shelter area. Use only when legal, do not assume firewood, and pack out waste; Sörmlandsleden does not provide firewood.

facilities.name: Viggudden toilet
facilities.description: OSM/Komoot/Vindskyddskartan-supported toilet east of the shelter; official stage text does not list it, so field-check condition.

facilities.name: Viggudden water of unknown quality
facilities.description: Vindskyddskartan notes water of unknown quality near the shelter; do not treat as potable without filtering/boiling and local verification.

facilities.name: Viggudden sea-water access
facilities.description: Sea-water/beach access near the shelter; useful for swimming/rest only, not a drinking-water refill. Check algae/conditions before swimming.

facilities.name: Ålbäck fishing village
facilities.description: Approximate coastal/cultural waypoint from official route description and map research; exact pin should be field-verified before treating as authoritative.

facilities.name: Dragsviken / stage 40 junction
facilities.description: OSM topology endpoint shared with stage 40; official stage 40 start is nearby at 58.632750,17.005017. Low-service endpoint with no parking at the immediate stage start.

facilities.name: Dragsviken no-parking warning
facilities.description: Access warning: official stage 40 says there is no parking at the stage start; plan pickup or use Långsjöns fågeltorn parking about 1 km away.

facilities.name: Dragsviken bay
facilities.description: Sea/bay context from OSM, not a drinking-water source. Use only as landscape/orientation context.

facilities.name: Långsjöns fågeltorn / Gäddfabriken parking
facilities.description: Practical parking for Dragsviken access, about 1 km by route/0.85 km direct from Dragsviken; Naturkartan notes about five cars.

facilities.name: Stage 39 complementary traffic caveat
facilities.description: Sörmlandstrafiken complementary traffic can cover Hummelvik/Östra Kovik/Ålbäck area, but may require advance weekday booking and is not a spontaneous trailhead bus.

facilities.name: Stora Utterviksvägen bus stop
facilities.description: Off-route bus access, roughly 2.7 km from Västra Kovik and much farther from Dragsviken; verify timetable.

facilities.name: Klenby bus stop
facilities.description: Off-route bus access, roughly 2.9 km from Västra Kovik and over 5 km from Dragsviken; verify timetable.

facilities.name: Ytterbovägen bus stop
facilities.description: Off-route bus access, roughly 3.1 km from Västra Kovik and about 4.5 km from Dragsviken; verify timetable.

facilities.name: Nyköping C train access
facilities.description: Nearest practical train anchor, roughly 15.7 km from Västra Kovik and 13.8 km from Dragsviken; far/off-route context only.
